newsitem.title: UK: British soldier held on N.Ireland gun charge.
newsitem.headline: British soldier held on N.Ireland gun charge.

text.p: A British soldier was charged on Saturday with an arms offence linked to a Northern Ireland shooting that was first blamed on Irish Republican Army guerrillas fighting to end Britain's rule.
A court in Antrim ordered Jonathan Smiley, 23, serving with the engineering corps, to be held in custody accused of having a weapon and ammunition in suspicious circumstances.
Two soldiers escaped injury when shots hit their vehicle at a roundabout on a road near Belfast International Airport in County Antrim on February 7.
"It is not now thought to be terrorist-related," a security source said.
